Method of Attack: Encrypts files on victim's system and demands ransom for decryption
Appends specific extensions to encrypted files
Uses ransomware payloads delivered via fake software sites promoted by Google and Bing ads
Impacted Systems: Victim systems infected by ransomware variants
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection via fake software sites and file encryption
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom notes named readme.txt and Black_Recover.txt
